criteria.reason: The exercise overflow menu adds a “Skip Exercise” option during workout logging.
Skipping prompts for confirmation before applying the change.
The skip action submits each set in the active week with status “skipped”.
The card displays a “Skipped” badge when all active-week sets are skipped.
The menu offers “Undo Skip Exercise” during the workout and clears the active-week sets.
The existing sets endpoint accepts and persists the skipped status.
A server test covers persisting skipped status, but does not test unskip behavior.
The diff adds no client test for the skip UI.
The harness reports all server and client tests passing.
The confirmation, menu, and badge copy is direct and contains no exclamation marks.
